description: This PHP source file defines the StreamWrapper class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. It provides an implementation that allows Guzzle HTTP streams to be used as PHP stream resources by implementing stream wrapper methods such as open, read, write, seek, and stat. The class facilitates converting streams to PHP resources and registers a custom stream wrapper scheme "guzzle".

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: Implements a PHP stream wrapper that adapts Guzzle streams to PHP stream resources, enabling stream operations such as reading, writing, seeking, and obtaining metadata.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns a PHP stream resource for the given Guzzle stream after registering the stream wrapper.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a stream context associated with a Guzzle stream, used for stream operations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the custom 'guzzle' stream wrapper if not already registered.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream resource, attaching the Guzzle stream to PHP's stream handling.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the wrapped Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the wrapped Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns a resource handle for the stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream, such as size and mode.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns metadata about a URL, here default to static values.
